title: DESK-MACRO-DAILY 3b(b): corporate-event study for ml_entry_eq - do ETF distributions (ex-dividend gaps in split-only bars) and the pool's reused tickers bias its labels and decisions?
note: Filed 2026-11-26 at the manager's ask (3b option b, 'so it isn't lost'). VERIFIED FACTS: (1) ml_entry_eq's population is NOT single names. ml/candidates/ml_entry_eq_v1, _v2_struct and _v3_struct_ens5 model.json pool_symbols = the same 173 symbols chosen by ml_entry_alpaca_score.POOL_RULE, which admits ETFs only (nasdaqtraded ETF=='Y'). So an earnings study has no population inside this model. (2) The applicable corporate events are ETF DISTRIBUTIONS. The bars are Alpaca 1Hour adjustment=split (POOL_RULE.bars_1h), so an ex-dividend gap (monthly for BIL/SHV/TLT/HYG/JNK/PFF/LQD/AGG..., quarterly for SPY/QQQ/sector SPDRs) is a price DROP in the label and bracket path. A long position's SL can hit on the ex-date although the holder receives the cash, and a short is charged it. (3) SIX pool symbols look like REUSED TICKERS: FB, INFO, NFX, ULTI, UN, SIX. In the 2019-2020 dev window these were companies (Facebook, IHS Markit, Newfield, Ultimate Software, Unilever NV, Six Flags), so POOL_RULE's dev-window liquidity screen may have scored a different security from the one the model now trades. UNVERIFIED: needs each symbol's Alpaca asset history / bars around the delisting. (4) PRICE-SOURCE GAP, as stated by the manager: for US equities on runners it is NOT a bars gap. research-script-run.yml passes the PAPER Alpaca pair to every unit's run step (row ALPACA-PAPER-KEYS-R3), and ml_entry_equity / alpaca_score already fetch SIP 1h + 1Day from it. The real gap is a POINT-IN-TIME DISTRIBUTION / EARNINGS CALENDAR HISTORY. Candidates: Alpaca /v1/corporate-actions with the paper pair (access UNVERIFIED), or yfinance dividends from a runner (reachability UNVERIFIED). The earnings snapshot (earnings-calendar-snapshot.yml) is forward-only since 2026-11-25. A single-name universe (if the operator wants one) would need its own pool rule plus a new Stage-0 population test, a separate unit. BUILD ESTIMATE ~1 lane-day: (a) probe both distribution sources on a runner and commit a fixture (~2 h); (b) a script that flags every frozen-artifact decision whose bracket window spans an ex-date, recomputes the label with the distribution added back (long) or charged (short), and reports the label-flip share and the net R difference with a decision-date-clustered CI (~4 h); (c) the ticker-reuse audit of the six symbols (~1 h); (d) a pre-registered queue unit (rule: the label-flip share and the dR on ex-date-spanning decisions; PASS = |dR| >= 0.05 R with CI excluding 0 -> a dividend-adjusted label recipe as the next iteration). Next action: the probe in (a). 2026-11-26 04:40Z: step (c), the ticker audit, moved FIRST per the manager (ml_entry_eq_struct is on alpaca_live). Live affordability reads (RQ-20261106-d5a1-01) price all six at ETF levels; NFX and SIX read no_bars there.
